strengths.title: Manufactured In-House
strengths.text: Magnetizers, coils and fixtures designed and built by our own team — so you deal directly with the manufacturer.

strengths.title: Engineered for Your Part
strengths.text: Machine energy, voltage and fixture design matched to your magnet material, part size and pole pattern.

strengths.title: Competitive Pricing
strengths.text: Transparent, factory-direct quotations for single machines, fixtures and repeat requirements.

strengths.title: Installation & Support
strengths.text: Help with commissioning, operator guidance and spares after delivery. {{Confirm installation, training and service offered}}

strengths.title: Fast Response
strengths.text: Quick replies to calls, WhatsApp messages and online enquiries, with clear next steps. {{Typical response time, e.g. within 2 working hours}}

strengths.title: Industrial Focus
strengths.text: Built for motor, automotive, audio, sensor and magnet manufacturers who magnetize parts every day.

processSteps.title: Share your part details
processSteps.text: Send the part drawing or sample, magnet material and grade, pole pattern and parts per hour.

processSteps.title: Application review
processSteps.text: Our engineers work out the energy, voltage and fixture needed to fully magnetize your part.

processSteps.title: Quotation & approval
processSteps.text: You receive a clear quotation for the machine, fixtures and options, with delivery time.

processSteps.title: Build, test & deliver
processSteps.text: We manufacture and test the system, then deliver it to your plant. {{Confirm trials, installation and training}}
